title: Microsoft Teams: alternate text for images shared from OneDrive and SharePoint
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the roadmap's November target from Microsoft's December Worldwide rollout notice. The editing control and its PowerShell command are documented; the broader file-permissions statement needs one additional citation.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans alternate text for images shared in Teams from OneDrive and SharePoint.
claims.quote: Improve accessibility by adding alternate text to images shared in Teams from OneDrive and SharePoint, helping users better understand visual content

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Users can add alt text while composing a message.
claims.quote: Users can add alt text to an image attachment while composing a message

claims.claim: Users can add or update the description later by editing their sent message.
claims.quote: can add or update the description later by editing their sent message.

claims.claim: Screen readers can announce the saved description when encountering the image in the Teams message.
claims.quote: Screen readers can announce the saved description when users encounter the image in the Teams message.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The description is associated with the image in that Teams message.
claims.quote: The description is associated with the image in that Teams message

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Adding the description does not modify the original image file in OneDrive or SharePoint.
claims.quote: it does not modify the original image file in OneDrive or SharePoint.

claims.claim: The affected people are Microsoft 365 users who share or receive image attachments stored in OneDrive and SharePoint through Teams.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 users who share or receive image attachments stored in OneDrive and SharePoint through Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this particular alt-text feature.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "alt text" "OneDrive" "SharePoint"; Teams alternate text image messaging policy disable Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy Microsoft Graph. Read accessibility-guide-admin, messaging-policies-in-teams and Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy; no feature-specific description found.

claims.claim: Microsoft's notice says no admin action is required.
claims.quote: No admin action is required.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout

claims.quote: You may want to: - Notify help desk staff and end users about the change.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends updating accessibility guidance to encourage concise, meaningful descriptions.
claims.quote: Update your organization's accessibility guidance to encourage concise, meaningful descriptions when sharing images in Microsoft Teams.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The Teams accessibility guide for admins recommends sharing Microsoft's guide on writing effective alt text.
claims.quote: Share the link how to write effective alt text with your organization to help users understand non-text messages shared in chat.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: MC1523086 identifies no compliance considerations.
claims.quote: [Compliance considerations:] No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

claims.claim: The notice describes no new permissions, sharing links or identities.
claims.quote: The description is associated with the image in that Teams message; it does not modify the original image file in OneDrive or SharePoint.

claims.claim: Access to the original shared file continues to depend on OneDrive and SharePoint permissions.
claims.quote: In Teams chat and channels, the file sharing settings are based on the sharing settings for SharePoint and OneDrive in the SharePoint admin center.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/troubleshoot/microsoftteams/files/guests-cannot-access-files to sources to support the OneDrive-and-SharePoint file-access statement; retain the existing limits-specifications-teams citation for SharePoint permissions.

claims.claim: The Teams limits page says permissions and file security options set in SharePoint are automatically reflected within Teams.
claims.quote: Files shared within a conversation are automatically added to the document library, and permissions and file security options set in SharePoint are automatically reflected within Teams.

claims.claim: The notice describes user-written descriptions, not generated or automatic alt text.
claims.quote: Users can add alt text to an image attachment while composing a message, and can add or update the description later by editing their sent message.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Edit sent messages lets users edit messages they sent in chat.
claims.quote: Edit sent messages - Use this setting to let users edit the messages that they sent in chat.

claims.claim: The editing control is at Teams admin center > Messaging policies > policy > Edit > Edit sent messages.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Microsoft Teams admin center, go to Messaging policies. Select the policy by clicking to the left of the policy name, and then select Edit. Edit sent messages - Use this setting to let users edit the messages that they sent in chat.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowUserEditMessage $true enables editing own messages in the specified policy.
claims.quote: -Identity: Identity for the teams messaging policy you're modifying. -AllowUserEditMessage: Determines whether a user is allowed to edit their own messages. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this to FALSE to prohibit.

claims.claim: No separate tenant or policy switch for this alt-text option is documented on the admin UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams alternate text image messaging policy disable Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy Microsoft Graph; "Teams" "alt text" "admin" "policy". Read messaging-policies-in-teams, accessibility-guide-admin and Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy syntax/parameters; no separate alt-text switch found.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The capability is user-opt-in: users choose to add descriptions, without a documented admin enablement switch.
claims.quote: Users can add alt text to an image attachment while composing a message. No admin action is required. Searched: Teams alternate text image messaging policy disable Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy Microsoft Graph; read messaging policy and cmdlet references, no separate enablement switch found.
